LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.Title: Purge directive: dynamic supply allocation
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.Enabled.Des: When enabled, supply allocation through "Contact cerebrex" adjusts prices dynamically and limits the amount of each supply that can be purchased over a period of time.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.Section.Tim: Supply replenishment and price recovery time (game days)
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.RefillDays: Time to fully replenish each supply's quota
Game days required for each supply's quota to recover from empty to full.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.PressureDay: After purchasing stops, accumulated purchase pressure halves every specified number of days.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.DemandDays: Markup decay time after node demand falls
After node demand falls, its markup gradually decays over the specified number of days.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.BenefitDays: Discount duration for deliveries of unneeded supplies
Discounts from delivering unneeded supplies gradually decay over the specified number of days.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.Section.Sup: Base prices and supply limits by category
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.MaterialPri: Common industrial material base price multiplier
Base selling price multiplier for materials such as steel, plasteel, and components.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.OrdinaryPri: Regular equipment and other supply base price multiplier
Base selling price multiplier for supplies such as regular weapons.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.ScarcePrice: Food, medicine, and apparel base price multiplier
Base selling price multiplier for available food, medicine, and apparel. The default ×3 means three times the original base cost.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.MaterialSup: Common industrial material supply limit multiplier
Maximum supply quota for each industrial material.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.OrdinarySup: Regular equipment and other supply limit multiplier
Maximum supply quota for each regular supply.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.ScarceSuppl: Food, medicine, and apparel supply limit multiplier
Maximum supply quota for each available food, medicine, and apparel item.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.Section.Con: Markup from global node construction demand
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.Protection: Minimum transaction price / delivery reward multiplier during construction
When node construction demand exists, the minimum transaction price is calculated from the delivery reward.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.DemandStren: Additional markup strength from global construction demand
Additional proportion charged for each full supply quota's worth of global demand for that supply.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.DemandCap: Additional markup limit from global construction demand
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.DemandCap.D: Limit on additional markup from node demand. Does not affect purchase-driven price increases or the minimum transaction price.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.Section.Pur: Price increases from recent large player purchases
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.PressureStr: Price increase strength from accumulated purchases
Proportional increase in subsequent selling prices for each full supply quota's worth of accumulated purchase value.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.PressureCap: Maximum additional markup from recent purchases
Maximum additional markup multiplier from recent purchases.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.Section.Del: Discounts from delivering unneeded supplies to nodes
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.BenefitStre: Price reduction strength from deliveries of unneeded supplies
Reduce the base selling price according to the ratio of delivery value to the supply limit.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Settings.BenefitCap: Accumulated discount limit for unneeded supplies
Maximum accumulated discount multiplier from deliveries of unneeded supplies.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.Stock: Available to request: {0} Daily replenishment: {1} Time until full: {2} days
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.InsufficientSupply: Insufficient supply. Reduce the order quantity.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.DetailsTip: Supplies of the same type share a supply quota and purchase pressure.
LanguageData.MAP_OvermindEconomy.PriceTip: Prices fluctuate under the influence of various factors.
